enhanced.description: Grants reduced charge time and increased handling speed for an improved short time immediately after swapping to this weapon.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

enhanced.name: Envious Assassin
enhanced.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers additional ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.

enhanced.name: No Distractions
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon for a very short period of time reduces flinch.

perks.name: Headstone
perks.description: Precision final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal at the victim's location.

enhanced.name: Headstone
enhanced.description: Precision final blows spawn a large Stasis crystal at a target's location.

perks.name: Enlightened Action
perks.description: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.

enhanced.name: Enlightened Action

perks.name: Chill Clip
perks.description: Direct hits with the top half of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

enhanced.name: Chill Clip
enhanced.description: Direct hits with the majority of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

perks.name: Firing Line
perks.description: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies.

enhanced.name: Firing Line
enhanced.description: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies. Handling is increased.

perks.name: Box Breathing

enhanced.name: Box Breathing

perks.name: High Ground
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

enhanced.name: High Ground
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks. Increases reload.
